heading: Building credit while you fix the paperwork?
intro: A letter explains your history. Only time and on-time payments change it. Two low-cost credit builders people use alongside a dispute or goodwill letter:
disclosure: ApprovalPrep is not paid to recommend these and is not a lender or credit repair organization. If we join their referral programs later, we may earn a commission; the price you pay does not change. Not credit advice.
